question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate antonym of the bracketed word.

We've learned that (calmness) spreads faster online than joy.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"calmness"** means a state of being free from agitation or strong emotions; it refers to serenity and tranquility. (शांति)

 
 
• **Example:** She found **calmness** by meditating every morning before starting her day.
 
 
 
• **"Rage"** refers to intense, uncontrollable anger. It is the opposite of calmness as it signifies extreme emotional agitation. (क्रोध)
 
 
• **Example:** He was filled with **rage** when he discovered the betrayal.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'calmness'** is **'rage'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sweetness** (मिठास): The quality of being sweet and pleasant.

 
 
• **Example:** The sweetness of the dessert made it a favorite among the children.
 
 
 
• **Cumbersome** (भारी): Large or heavy and therefore difficult to carry or use; unwieldy.
 
 
• **Example:** The cumbersome package was difficult to maneuver through the narrow hallway.
 
 
 
• **Calamity** (आपदा): An event causing great and often sudden damage or distress; a disaster.
 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake was a calamity that affected thousands of people.
